caption: The drawing shows two textile objects on a plain, muted grayish-green background. The larger object on the left is a bonnet, cream-colored or off-white, shaped with a rounded back and a reinforced front edge. It is heavily decorated with floral embroidery in light hues: white flowers, yellow accents, and delicate patterns run along a vertical band near the face opening and across the surface. The stitching alternates between small lines and dots, with leafy and flower-like designs throughout. The bonnet has white ties attached to either side for fastening. Below the larger bonnet is a smaller cap, depicted in a pale gray or beige color. The smaller cap is semi-circular with a curved bottom edge and a short pair of light-colored cords or ribbons hanging from it. It is decorated with a diamond-shaped embroidered motif in blue and white at its center, containing a small floral design. The background is a plain, flat color bordered by a beige margin, and the lower right corner is signed “M. Concha.”
title: Baby's Cap
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
